fatal_errors: The predicted 20% lattice-parameter increase is unsupported and inconsistent with the reported outcomes.
The proposed thermal-expansion mechanism misses the central surface-energy-driven Au/Cu segregation, active diffusion, melting, and evaporation mechanism.
The heating rate and maximum temperature do not match the target protocol.
The method omits atom-resolved aberration-corrected STEM-EDS and molecular dynamics simulations needed to connect composition, shape evolution, and diffusivity.
explanation: In-situ heated electron microscopy under vacuum is directionally appropriate for studying nanoparticle behavior at atomic resolution, so the response partially identifies the experimental approach. However, it replaces the central scientific result with an unevidenced lattice-expansion claim. The target study found non-sluggish diffusion, Au/Cu surface segregation, shape evolution, loss of small particles, and evaporation near 973 K, rather than a 20% lattice expansion at 800°C. Its lattice-only falsification experiment would not discriminate entropy stabilization from kinetically controlled surface segregation.
